items.stem: A senior HR leader is asked how HR adds strategic value. Which statement best reflects a strategic HR role?

options.text: Aligning workforce capability and programs with the organization's business goals
options.rationale: Correct: strategic HR links people decisions to business direction and outcomes.

options.text: Processing payroll and maintaining attendance records
options.rationale: These are operational tasks, not strategic leadership.

options.text: Filing regulatory paperwork only when audited
options.rationale: Reactive compliance is not strategy and invites risk.

options.text: Keeping HR activity separate from business planning
options.rationale: Isolating HR from planning is the opposite of a strategic role.

items.explanation: Correct: strategic HR links people decisions to business direction and outcomes.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Two critical roles will become vacant in 12 months. What is the most appropriate senior-HR response?

options.text: Activate a succession plan that develops internal candidates and tracks readiness
options.rationale: Correct: succession planning prepares pipelines ahead of predictable vacancies.

options.text: Wait until the roles are empty, then post them externally
options.rationale: Reactive hiring risks long gaps in critical roles.

options.text: Promote by seniority regardless of readiness
options.rationale: Seniority alone does not ensure capability for the role.

options.text: Freeze the roles to save budget
options.rationale: Freezing critical roles harms operations and is not planning.

items.explanation: Correct: succession planning prepares pipelines ahead of predictable vacancies.

items.stem: Select TWO practices that strengthen a defensible total-rewards decision.

options.text: Benchmarking pay against relevant external market data
options.rationale: Correct: market data supports fair, competitive pay decisions.

options.text: Documenting the rationale and internal equity analysis
options.rationale: Correct: documentation and equity review make decisions defensible.

options.text: Setting pay based on a manager's personal preference
options.rationale: Personal preference introduces bias and risk.

options.text: Hiding the pay structure from all employees permanently
options.rationale: Secrecy alone is not a sound rewards practice.

options.text: Changing criteria for each individual case
options.rationale: Inconsistent criteria undermine equity and defensibility.

items.explanation: Correct: market data supports fair, competitive pay decisions. Correct: documentation and equity review make decisions defensible.
